articles.title: A Teen's Bluetooth Speaker Named 'BOMB' Forces a Plane to Turn Back!
articles.summary: A United Airlines flight to Spain had to return to Newark after someone named their Bluetooth device 'BOMB.' Passengers were evacuated while the plane was checked. The flight landed 9.5 hours late.

articles.title: AI Company Anthropic Plans to Go Public—and It's Worth Almost a Trillion Dollars!
articles.summary: Anthropic, the company behind the AI chatbot Claude, is preparing to sell shares to the public for the first time. It was recently valued at $965 billion, making it one of the most valuable companies in the world.

articles.title: Hungary's New Leader Wants to Kick Out the President—by Changing the Rules!
articles.summary: Prime Minister Péter Magyar plans to change Hungary's constitution to remove President Tamás Sulyok. Magyar calls Sulyok a 'puppet' of the old leader and says he must go. The president refuses to resign.
